items.evidence: Existing phone, ER line and 24h confirmed; Arabic eligibility note added. KAMC Riyadh page: 'Phone: +966-11-8011111'. ER page: 'The public can access this center by calling this number: 0118011115' (Emergency Command Center); 'All areas of Emergency Department has been managed and observed by the ED Coordinators for 24 hours'; 'provides care to all eligible patients who present to the department'. Eligibility page: eligible non-National Guard patients include 'Emergency room patients as identified in the guidelines for ineligible patient presenting to the emergency department'.

Operating with its own paediatric ER: mngha.med.sa lists 'مستشفى الملك عبدالله التخصصي للأطفال - الرياض' (page last modified 9/27/2026) and its Pediatric Emergency Medicine Department page (Triage Area, Urgent Care Unit, Resuscitation Unit, Acute Care Unit). The KASCH pages publish no phone and no ER hours: the entry's +966118011111 is the King Abdulaziz Medical City switchboard, which the KAMC Riyadh page states ('Phone: +966-11-8011111'), not a KASCH-specific number.
